voices.note: the mishna's anonymous first tanna (29b.4): no untanned hides from the suspect
anonymous voice of the Gemara giving each tanna's reason

props.gloss_en: the tanna kamma: one does not buy from one suspect regarding firstborns hides that are not tanned [even of females]
R' Eliezer: one may buy from him hides of females
what is the reason? it is known [that the hide is a female's]
if so, [he will sell] a male's too: he cuts away its maleness and says 'mice ate it'
and the other: the place [eaten by] mice is known

supports.gloss_en: מאי טעמא? מידע ידיע -- a female's hide is recognisable as such, so buying it carries no firstborn concern
ותנא קמא -- אם כן, זכר נמי חייק לזכרותיה ואמר עכברים אכלוה: permit females and he will pass off a male's hide by cutting away the male part
ואידך -- בי עכברים מידע ידיע: R' Eliezer's rejoinder to the TK's concern -- a place eaten by mice is recognisable, so the ruse would not succeed
